name: Best-of read duel
summary: Both sides pick one of three moves in secret; a cycle of counters decides each round, and patterns give you away.
core_loop: pick a move → opponent picks → reveal → winner scores → best of N
rules: rock beats scissors, scissors beats paper, paper beats rock
the AI or friend follows a pattern
example_prompts: rock paper scissors but wizard spells
best of five against my cat

name: Quick-draw duel
summary: Wait for the signal then tap faster than the opponent; tapping early loses the round.
core_loop: stare at idle screen → signal appears at a random time → tap → compare times
example_prompts: western quick draw duel with cats
tap faster than my friend after the signal

name: Fighting-lite
summary: Two fighters with simple moves: tap to attack, hold to block, swipe for a special; spacing and timing beat button mashing.
core_loop: step in → tap attack → opponent blocks or hits → special meter fills → finish

name: Turn-menu friend duel
summary: Two creatures or heroes exchange turns choosing attack, defend or heal; the winner is who manages HP and cooldowns better.
core_loop: pick an action → opponent picks → resolve → HP updates → repeat
example_prompts: pokemon battle against my best friend with school mascots
turn based duel with wizard cats
final fantasy duel but we are bakers

name: Card clash
summary: Each round both play a card and the higher relevant stat wins; choose which card to spend each round.
core_loop: pick a card → opponent picks → compare chosen stat → winner takes round → best of N
rules: stat to compare is chosen by the round
example_prompts: card duel with dragons and unicorns
triple triad but the cards are pizza toppings

name: Rhythm rap battle
summary: The opponent plays a note pattern and you repeat it on beat; a crowd meter swings between you.
core_loop: opponent pattern → your turn to repeat → beats scored → meter shifts → next phrase
example_prompts: friday night funkin style battle with my teacher

name: Quiz duel
summary: Both answer the same question; a correct faster answer damages the opponent's HP, and wrong answers hurt you.
core_loop: question appears → both answer → faster correct deals damage → HP updates → next
social_hooks: async quiz duel with a friend
example_prompts: harry potter quiz duel with my friend
trivia duel where right answers deal damage

name: Typing duel
summary: Both players type the same phrase; progress shows live and the first accurate finish wins.
core_loop: phrase shown → both type → progress bars race → first correct wins

name: Tap tug-of-war
summary: Both tap as fast as possible to pull a marker toward their side; surges and pauses matter.
core_loop: tap to pull → marker moves → hit power-ups → pull to opponent's line
social_hooks: beat friends on the same rope
example_prompts: tug of war but with cats
tap as fast as you can to beat my friend

name: Parry and riposte
summary: The opponent telegraphs high, mid or low swings; match your guard and parry on time to counter.
core_loop: opponent swings → swipe guard direction → parry window → riposte hits
example_prompts: sekiro parry duel against my gym teacher

name: Artillery duel
summary: Two tanks on terrain take turns choosing angle and power; hits destroy terrain and reduce HP.
core_loop: wait for turn → aim → shoot → shell arcs → terrain changes → opponent shoots
example_prompts: tank duel on a hill with my cat

name: Attack-block-charge
summary: Each round choose Charge, Block or Attack; attacks need charges, blocks stop one attack, and bluffing wins.
core_loop: secretly choose → reveal → resolve → charges update → repeat
example_prompts: shoot block reload but with wizards
charge block attack duel with my friend

name: Boxing dodge-punch
summary: Opponent boxer shows tells; dodge left/right then counter when they are open, while stamina limits punches.
core_loop: watch tell → dodge direction → counter punch → stamina → knockout
example_prompts: punch out but the boxers are cats
boxing dodge game with a dragon champion

name: Jousting charge
summary: Gallop toward each other; tilt your lance height and tap at the right moment to hit while the opponent adjusts.
core_loop: pick lance height → gallop → tap to strike → hit or miss → next pass
example_prompts: jousting but my horse is a goat
lance duel for a pizza crown

name: Dodgeball duel
summary: Throw balls at the opponent and dodge theirs; catching a ball reverses it.
core_loop: move → throw → opponent dodges → catch to counter → HP
rules: catching in time nets a free throw
example_prompts: throw and dodge duel in a gym

name: Wizard spell duel
summary: Each wizard casts spell sequences (swipes or typed incantations); the faster correct cast hits first.
core_loop: spell prompt → cast by drawing or typing → faster correct hits → shield blocks → repeat
example_prompts: harry potter duel with my friend

name: Insult swordfight
summary: Trade insults; the right comeback answers the insult and wins the exchange, and you learn new insults by losing.
core_loop: opponent insults → pick comeback → right one wins exchange → exchanges counted → bout
rules: each insult has a matching comeback
you learn new ones from losses
example_prompts: monkey island insult fighting but with cats

name: Pet stat battle
summary: Your pet's raised stats and chosen moves duke it out against a friend's pet; strategy is the build, not the fight.
core_loop: pick 3 moves → pets battle automatically → damage replay → result
example_prompts: battle my pet dragon against my friend's pet cat
build moves and watch the pets fight

name: Puzzle battle
summary: Solve a falling-block or match puzzle; clearing sends garbage blocks to the opponent's board.
core_loop: play puzzle → clear lines → send garbage → opponent's board fills → topout
social_hooks: race a friend on the same piece sequence
example_prompts: puzzle duel where clears send garbage

name: Build-and-fight mech
summary: Spend a budget on weapons, armor and legs; the robot auto-fights an opponent's build and result depends on matchup.
core_loop: pick parts → total weight/cost → fight resolves → result shows why → tweak
example_prompts: build a mech to beat my friend's mech

name: Stamina brawl
summary: Each exchange costs stamina; choose between a heavy strike, a light combo or resting, and the opponent chooses too.
core_loop: choose attack weight → stamina deducted → damage → recover → knockout
rules: resting recovers but opens you up
example_prompts: brawl where stamina is the real health bar

name: Peek-and-throw snowball
summary: Duck behind a fort and peek to throw; the opponent does the same, and timing the peek is everything.
core_loop: duck → peek → throw → opponent peeks → hit or miss
example_prompts: peek and throw duel behind a fort

name: Ghost duel
summary: Play the same short challenge as a friend's recorded run; beat their ghost's score or time.
core_loop: open friend's ghost → play same seed → compare score → send back
rules: ghost plays exactly what they did
tie goes to the earlier run
social_hooks: beat friends' ghosts in the feed
post a ghost to your Group
example_prompts: send a ghost challenge to my group

name: Bracket ladder
summary: A mini-tournament of 8 duels in a bracket; you advance by winning short duels, with brackets shared with friends.
core_loop: play match → advance → next opponent harder → final → trophy
example_prompts: a bracket tournament of my friends
mini smash tournament with school mascots

name: Pong duel
summary: Two paddles bounce a puck; angle and spin decide, with the speed ramping each volley.
core_loop: serve → paddle drag → puck bounces → score at goal → first to 7

name: Standoff patience
summary: Both samurai stare and shift; strike during the instant the opponent flinches, but striking too soon is fatal.
core_loop: watch opponent → flinch cue → strike swipe → cut or be cut → next bout
example_prompts: wait for the flinch and strike
duel where whoever moves first loses

name: Pattern battle
summary: Players alternate extending a pattern; the first to fail to repeat the full pattern loses.
core_loop: see pattern → repeat it → add a step → pass → repeat
example_prompts: extend the pattern until someone slips

name: Shooting gallery duel
summary: Both shoot the same targets; the faster tap scores the target, so priority and speed matter.
core_loop: targets appear → tap fastest → score claims → next target → 20 targets
rules: each target scores for the first shooter
example_prompts: carnival shooting gallery against my friend
shoot the dragons faster than my buddy

name: Hide and seek
summary: One player picks a hiding spot; the other searches with limited guesses, getting hints along the way.
core_loop: hider picks a spot → seeker guesses → hint reveals proximity → guess again → found or not
social_hooks: hide a spot for a friend async
example_prompts: hide and seek in a haunted house with friends
pick a spot and my friend guesses

name: Territory tap war
summary: Tap squares to claim them; an opponent can re-tap them, and the most squares after the timer wins.
core_loop: tap squares → claim → opponent re-claims → timer ends → count
rules: held squares tick a small bonus
social_hooks: team up Groups on one canvas
example_prompts: r/place mini war with my friends
team color war for our groups

name: Mirror build duel
summary: Build a team within a budget; it battles other players' stored teams automatically, with results shown.
core_loop: draft a team → submit → fight stored team → result → next
example_prompts: super auto pets with my friend's teams
build a team to fight friends' lineups

name: Arm wrestle rhythm
summary: Tap in rhythm to charge, then burst to push the arm over; mistimed taps lose ground.
core_loop: tap to charge on rhythm → burst when meter full → arms move → opponent resists

name: Gravity-well spaceship duel
summary: Two ships circle a gravity well, rotating and thrusting to line up shots while avoiding the star.
core_loop: thrust and rotate → fire → gravity bends paths → hit or crash → respawn

name: Tank maze duel
summary: Two tanks in a maze fire bouncing bullets; use ricochets to hit around corners while avoiding your own shots.
core_loop: drive → aim → fire a bouncing bullet → opponent dodges → hit
rules: hits remove the tank for the round

name: Copy-the-shot duel
summary: One player makes a trick shot; the other must replicate the same angle and power, or collect a letter.
core_loop: leader aims a shot → make it → follower copies → miss gives a letter → swap
social_hooks: challenge a friend with a trick shot
example_prompts: copy my trick shot to avoid letters

name: Dance-off copycat
summary: One dancer shows a short move sequence; the other copies the moves by tap or swipe on beat, scoring accuracy.
core_loop: watch moves → copy with taps/swipes on beat → accuracy shown → swap
social_hooks: send a dance routine to friends
example_prompts: just dance duel with my cat
copy my moves on the beat
